identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study of Tislelizumab (BGB-A317) Versus Chemotherapy as Second Line Treatment in Participants With Advanced Esophageal Squamous Cell Carcinoma
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Randomized, Controlled, Open-label, Global Phase 3 Study Comparing the Efficacy of the Anti-PD-1 Antibody Tislelizumab (BGB-A317) Versus Chemotherapy as Second Line Treatment in Patients With Advanced Unresectable/Metastatic Esophageal Squamous Cell Carcinoma

armGroups.label: Tislelizumab
armGroups.description: Tislelizumab on Day 1, given every 21 days

armGroups.label: Investigator chosen chemotherapy (ICC)
armGroups.description: Paclitaxel on Day 1, given every 21 days or on a weekly schedule; OR Docetaxel on Day 1, given every 21 days; OR Irinotecan on Days 1 and 8, given every 21 days

interventions.name: Paclitaxel
interventions.description: 135-175 mg /m² administered IV , or 80-100 mg/m\^2 administered IV according to local guidelines for standard of care

interventions.name: Docetaxel
interventions.description: 75 mg/m\^2 administered IV or 70 mg/m\^2 IV in Japan
